steps.title: Sketch the panel
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as skin_panel.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front).
Draw a rectangle 580 wide and 630 high, its bottom left corner 400 along and 160 up from the origin, so the panel sits where it does in the leaf.

steps.title: Extrude the plate
actions: Click Extrude. Distance 12 mm. Click OK.
steps.note: The panel is held on all four edges by the girders, the heel post and a stiffener, so in the FEA all four edge faces are fixed.
